facts.claim: Australia's GST is 10%, and hotel, motel and hostel stays of under 28 days carry it in full.

sources.title: ATO: commercial residential premises and GST

facts.claim: No tourist or hotel tax is in force in Sydney in October 2026: Revenue NSW's list of state taxes, duties and levies includes none on accommodation, and no city levy was found.

sources.title: Revenue NSW: taxes, duties, levies and royalties

facts.note: Negative finding, not an official statement that none exists.

facts.claim: Since 1 January 2025 Victoria charges a short stay levy of 7.5% of the total booking fee on stays under 28 days in entire homes, apartments and rooms that are not the host's main residence, paid by the booking platform; hotels, motels and hostels are excluded as commercial residential accommodation.

sources.title: State Revenue Office Victoria: understanding the short stay levy
